ideas.name: settlement cross continues
ideas.why: yesterday's settlement is where the day's margin and P&L reset; a decisive cross through it puts the other side's positions underwater and they cover

ideas.name: settlement rejection
ideas.why: a test of settlement that is pushed back off it shows the defenders there; price moves away

ideas.name: into the settlement, toward VWAP
ideas.why: the settle is an average price over the close and MOC / hedging flows trade around the day's average, so late price is pulled toward VWAP

ideas.name: settle-to-settle momentum
ideas.why: a day that settled well above (below) the settle before leaves trend followers and margin-driven flows pushing the same way next morning

ideas.name: far from settlement, fade
ideas.why: by mid-morning, a price far from settlement has stretched the day's P&L for the losing side and draws mean-reverting liquidity

ideas.name: flip1 on the settlement side
ideas.why: a flip that points away from settlement, with price already beyond it, has the day's winners behind it

ideas.name: flip1 just through settlement
ideas.why: a flip within 15 minutes of price crossing settlement its way joins the cross

ideas.name: potM1 at settlement
ideas.why: easing momentum right at the settlement level is a defended level holding
